e.title: Haute
e.summary: 开源保险定价引擎（PricingFrontier）：可云部署的现代定价平台
e.body: Haute（PricingFrontier，PyPI 0.3.3，AGPL-3.0）是开源保险定价引擎：费率计算、定价模型的工程化平台，可部署到 Databricks/AWS/GCP/Azure/Docker。对 RIAA：定价从脚本到系统的开源路径——个人定价模型（[[insurancerating]]/[[machine-learning-pricing]]）→ 生产级定价引擎的桥梁；与 [[tweedie-python]]（分布定价）配套做完整定价服务；开源（AGPL）+ 云部署展示「模型 → 服务」的工程范式；定价岗位面试/项目作品的技术亮点。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.3.3 + GitHub 确认（开源定价引擎、多云部署），未实测
e.summary_en: Open-source insurance pricing engine (PricingFrontier): cloud-deployable modern pricing platform
e.summary_hk: 開源保險定價引擎（PricingFrontier）：可雲部署的現代定價平台
e.body_en: Haute (PricingFrontier, PyPI 0.3.3, AGPL-3.0) is an open-source insurance pricing engine: an engineered platform for rate calculations and pricing models, deployable to Databricks/AWS/GCP/Azure/Docker. For RIAA: the open-source path from pricing script to system — the bridge from personal pricing models ([[insurancerating]]/[[machine-learning-pricing]]) to a production-grade pricing engine; paired with [[tweedie-python]] (distributional pricing) it builds a complete pricing service; open source (AGPL) + cloud deployment shows the model → service engineering paradigm; a technical highlight for pricing-job interviews and portfolios.
e.body_hk: Haute（PricingFrontier，PyPI 0.3.3，AGPL-3.0）是開源保險定價引擎：費率計算、定價模型的工程化平台，可部署到 Databricks/AWS/GCP/Azure/Docker。對 RIAA：定價從腳本到系統的開源路徑——個人定價模型（[[insurancerating]]/[[machine-learning-pricing]]）→ 生產級定價引擎的橋樑；與 [[tweedie-python]]（分佈定價）配套做完整定價服務；開源（AGPL）+ 雲部署展示「模型 → 服務」的工程範式；定價崗位面試/項目作品的技術亮點。
